question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH wholesale_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        substr(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS year,
        vc.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
        ROUND(SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    INNER JOIN veg_cat vc ON w.item_code = vc.item_code
    GROUP BY substr(w.whsle_date, 1, 4), vc.category_name
),
selling_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS year,
        vc.category_name,
        ROUND(SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg"), 2) AS total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    INNER JOIN veg_cat vc ON t.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE t."sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4), vc.category_name
),
loss_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(vlr."loss_rate_%"), 2) AS avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df vlr
    INNER JOIN veg_cat vc ON vlr.item_code = vc.item_code
    GROUP BY vc.category_name
),
wholesale_cost AS (
    SELECT 
        substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS year,
        vc.category_name,
        ROUND(SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg" * t."qty_sold(kg)"), 2) AS total_wholesale_cost
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    INNER JOIN veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code = w.item_code 
        AND substr(t.txn_date, 1, 10) = substr(w.whsle_date, 1, 10)
    INNER JOIN veg_cat vc ON t.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE t."sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4), vc.category_name
)
SELECT 
    wm.year,
    wm.category_name,
    wm.avg_wholesale_price,
    wm.max_wholesale_price,
    wm.min_wholesale_price,
    wm.wholesale_price_difference,
    wm.total_wholesale_price,
    sm.total_selling_price,
    lm.avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(wc.total_wholesale_cost * lm.avg_loss_rate / 100.0, 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(sm.total_selling_price - wc.total_wholesale_cost - (wc.total_wholesale_cost * lm.avg_loss_rate / 100.0), 2) AS profit
FROM wholesale_metrics wm
INNER JOIN selling_metrics sm ON wm.year = sm.year AND wm.category_name = sm.category_name
INNER JOIN loss_metrics lm ON wm.category_name = lm.category_name
INNER JOIN wholesale_cost wc ON wm.year = wc.year AND wm.category_name = wc.category_name
ORDER BY wm.year, wm.category_name
